audience: Real-estate agencies that list properties and manage leads in EasyBroker

useCases.title: Search properties by rooms and price
useCases.text: List the properties with filters for status, type, price and bedrooms. Open one property to read its full details.

useCases.title: Review contacts and their probability
useCases.text: List the contacts with filters for status, probability, tag and dates. Open one contact to read its full record.

useCases.title: Read enquiries for a property
useCases.text: List the contact requests received in a period or for one property. Open the property to read its details.

useCases.title: Log a new enquiry for a property
useCases.text: Create a contact request about a property. Each call creates a new record, and the agent can be notified.

useCases.title: Update the status or tags of a lead
useCases.text: Change only the fields you send on an existing contact, such as status, probability or tags. The live contact record changes.

useCases.title: Look up locations and property features
useCases.text: Find a location by name or postal code. List the property types and features for a listing.
